title: Tiered commitment bundles and migration plan for low-latency regions
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: define and coordinate a tiered reservations product (commitment bundles) for latency-sensitive regions (EU-CENTRAL and APAC-SE) and a migration path for existing dedicated customers. This ticket covers GTM materials, release-note copy, billing integration checks, and cross-team launch sequencing.

Scope: product definition (bundle SKUs, minimum commitments, burst credits), UX copy for Console reservation flow, billing & invoicing mapping, backend feature flags for region availability, migration tooling for current reservation customers, release notes and partner enablement docs.

Success metrics: 1) First-week provisioning rate >= 80% for signups in target regions; 2) Migration tool reduces manual ops time by >= 60% (measured via runbook time logs); 3) No P0 incidents during first 72 hours after GA.

Key stakeholders: PM (Aisha), Eng (Marco, Lina Chen), Billing (Diego Morales), Console UX (Priya Rao), Legal & Compliance (Sarah Nguyen), Sales Enablement (Riley Park), Solutions Eng (Karthik Menon), SRE (Olatunde Adebayo).

Out-of-scope: wholesale SKU redesign for Dedicated global fleet, price changes to existing Reserved customers outside the two targeted regions.

Decisions to make: final tier naming (we propose: Starter / Pro / Enterprise), minimum commit sizes (proposed 100/500/2000 token-hours), burst credit policy, whether to include upfront discount or monthly commitment pricing.

Launch artifacts to produce: launch PRD, console copy deck, pricing matrix, release notes draft, migration runbook, billing mapping spec, beta customer invite list, monitoring dashboard template.

acceptance_criteria: Console shows new tiered bundle options when user region is EU-CENTRAL or APAC-SE
Billing emits single bundle invoice line with region and instance tags
Migration tool can convert existing reservations to new bundles with <15 mins manual intervention per account
Release notes approved by Legal and Product Marketing
Runbook and SRE dashboards deployed and smoke-tested
rollout_stages: Alpha (internal): feature flag enabled for Redwood employees + internal beta customers — week 1
Private beta: select customers in EU-CENTRAL and APAC-SE invited — week 2-3
Gradual GA: traffic ramp with region-by-region enablement and doubled monitoring windows — week 4-6
Full GA: public release + documentation + marketing announcement — week 7
notes: Risk: billing schema mismatch could delay GA by 2+ weeks. Mitigation: parallel billing shim and invoice migration plan. For marketing, prepare staggered messaging to avoid over-promising immediate global availability. Contact list for beta invites maintained in Sales Enablement doc.
